question: According to Census of India 2011, which of the following states recorded apopulation density of more than 1100 persons per km²?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bihar** recorded a population density of more than **1100 persons per km²** according to the **Census of India 2011**.
 
• **Population density** is an important metric that indicates the **number of people living per unit area**, typically per square kilometer.
 
• High population density can impact various aspects of life, including infrastructure, resources, and quality of living.
 
• Bihar, being one of the most densely populated states, faces unique challenges and opportunities in terms of development and resource management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Population density** is calculated by dividing the total population of a region by its land area.
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, **Bihar** had a population density of approximately 1102 persons per km².
 
• Other states with high population density include West Bengal and Kerala, though they did not exceed 1100 persons per km² according to the 2011 Census.
 
• Understanding population density helps in urban planning, allocation of resources, and implementation of policies for sustainable development.
